T: Strong side. Left side. Dinner side.
D: A newly integrated high school football team in 1971 Virginia comes together under a new coach.
P: Serve the main after the big game.
S: Ham, salami and provolone sub with oregano vinaigrette and pickled peppers

Long rolls stacked with ham, salami, provolone, shredded lettuce, tomato, pickled peppers and a tangy oregano vinaigrette, cut into chunks to share. Whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp dried oregano and pepper. Split 2 long baguettes and drizzle the insides with half the dressing. Layer with 150g sliced ham, 100g salami and 100g provolone. Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, thin red onion and pickled peppers, then the rest of the dressing. Press closed, wrap tightly for 10 minutes and cut each into 4.
Franks in toasted buns with beef chilli and melted cheddar

Grilled frankfurts in toasted buns smothered in beef chilli, diced onion, mustard and melted cheddar. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, 200g passata and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes. Toast 8 hot dog buns. Fill each with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli, scatter with 120g grated cheddar and grill 2 minutes to melt. Top with diced white onion and mustard.
M: Buttermilk fried chicken, mashed potato, pepper gravy and chilli honey

Buttermilk brined chicken fried crisp and golden, with creamy mash, peppery white gravy and hot honey on the side. Soak 1.2kg chicken pieces in 400ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp hot sauce for at least 2 hours. Toss in 200g plain flour mixed with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and salt. Fry at 165C for 12 to 15 minutes until golden and cooked through. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with butter and milk. Make gravy with 30g butter, 2 tbsp flour, 400ml milk and lots of pepper. Warm 3 tbsp honey with chilli flakes.
W: Cinnamon peaches under a buttermilk biscuit topping, ice cream

Juicy spiced peaches baked under a golden buttermilk biscuit topping with cinnamon sugar crunch, served warm with vanilla ice cream. Toss 2 x 820g tins drained sliced peaches with 60g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tbsp cornflour and a squeeze of lemon and tip into a baking dish. Rub 80g cold butter into 200g self-raising flour and 2 tbsp sugar, then stir in 150ml buttermilk. Drop spoonfuls over the peaches and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar mixed with cinnamon. Bake at 190C for 30 minutes until golden. Serve warm with ice cream.
K: Sweet black tea mixed with fresh lemonade and mint

Half Southern sweet tea, half fresh lemonade, poured over ice with lemon wheels and mint for a hot Virginia afternoon. Steep 6 black tea bags in 700ml boiling water with 80g sugar for 5 minutes, then remove the bags and chill. Stir 80g sugar into the juice of 5 lemons and 500ml cold water until dissolved. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the tea to halfway and top with the lemonade. Garnish with lemon wheels and mint.

Brown the plant-based mince with most of the onion in the oil.
Add the cumin, paprika, chilli powder, passata and a splash of water and simmer until thick.
Grill the vegetarian frankfurts.
Toast the hot dog buns.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Combine the chicken, buttermilk, salt and hot sauce in a bowl.
Soak in the fridge for at least 2 hours.
Toss the chicken in flour mixed with paprika, garlic powder and salt.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 165C in batches until golden and cooked through.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Make gravy with butter, flour, milk and lots of pepper.
Warm the honey with chilli flakes to drizzle over the chicken.

veg.make_ahead: Soak up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Cut the cauliflower into large florets and combine with the buttermilk, hot sauce and half the salt. Soak in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Peel, chop and boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with 60 g of the butter and 200 ml of the milk.
Mix 200 g of the flour with the paprika, garlic powder and the rest of the salt and toss the cauliflower through it.
Fry in the vegetable oil at 175C in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and tender.
Melt the last of the butter, stir in the remaining flour, whisk in the rest of the milk and the pepper and simmer into a gravy.
Warm the honey with the chilli flakes and drizzle over the cauliflower.
